description: This file defines and manages month-related functionalities for a date library, including formatting, parsing, locale handling, and utility functions for months.

methods.name: daysInMonth
methods.description: Calculates the number of days in a given month of a specific year.

methods.name: localeMonths
methods.description: Returns localized month names based on locale data, format, or index.

methods.name: localeMonthsShort
methods.description: Returns localized short month names based on locale data, format, or index.

methods.name: localeMonthsParse
methods.description: Parses month names or abbreviations into month index, with strict and lenient options.

methods.name: setMonth
methods.description: Sets the month of a moment object, adjusting the date if necessary.

methods.name: getSetMonth
methods.description: Getter/setter for the month of a moment object.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the current month of a moment object.

methods.name: monthsShortRegex
methods.description: Returns regex for matching short month names, with strictness options.

methods.name: monthsRegex
methods.description: Returns regex for matching month names, with strictness options.
